meta.title_passenger: Tuk Tuk Passenger — Move around your city
meta.title_driver: Tuk Tuk Driver — Earn on the go
meta.description: Tuk Tuk — Mototaxis in your neighborhood. Request a ride, drive, or manage your fleet from the company panel.

passenger.title: Move around your city with Tuk Tuk Passenger
passenger.lead: The app to request mototaxi rides, follow your trip in real time, chat with the driver, and discover available riders in your area.

driver.title: Earn income with Tuk Tuk Driver
driver.lead: Go online, receive passenger requests near you, navigate the trip, and manage your daily rides. You can also join a fleet or cooperative.

fleet.title: Manage your fleet with the Tuk Tuk panel
fleet.lead: Create your company, choose a plan, invite drivers, control wallet and geo channels. The admin runs the cooperative; passengers and drivers use the real-time app.

passenger.benefits_lead: Tuk Tuk connects passengers with mototaxi drivers in your area, with tools designed to move fast and with confidence.
passenger.b1_text: Find active drivers near you and request rides whenever you need them, any time of day.
passenger.b2_text: Get a quote before you ride and know the trip value with no surprises. You pay what was agreed.
passenger.b3_text: Follow the route on the map, chat during the trip, and use in-app safety tools.
passenger.services_title: There's a Tuk Tuk for you
passenger.services_lead: As a passenger you request the ride, watch the live map, and coordinate pickup without friction.
passenger.s1_text: Request a mototaxi from your phone, set origin and destination, and get offers from nearby drivers.
passenger.s2_text: See the route, trip status, and location throughout the service.
passenger.s3_text: Coordinate pickup and drop-off details without leaving the app.
passenger.s4_text: Discover mototaxis and mobility supply in your neighborhood with geofences and area channels.
passenger.s5_text: Review past requests, completed statuses, and your recent activity.
passenger.s6_text: Know if your mototaxi is on the way, at the meeting point, or finishing the trip.
passenger.how_lead: Sign in with your Google account and start moving in minutes.
passenger.step1_text: Access with Google from the web or your device. No long forms.
passenger.step2_text: Set origin and destination, review the quote, and request a nearby mototaxi.
passenger.step3_text: Follow the map, chat, and close the trip when you arrive.
passenger.highlight_text: With geographic channels and geofences, Tuk Tuk shows active mototaxi supply in your area. Ideal for neighborhoods, urban zones, and local operators.
passenger.lost_text: From the app you can contact the driver or report an issue with your trip to get help.
passenger.cta_title: Want to drive with Tuk Tuk?
passenger.cta_text: Earn with your mototaxi, manage your schedule, and receive passenger requests near you. You can also run your own fleet from the company panel.

driver.benefits_lead: Go online, receive nearby requests, and manage your daily rides from your phone.
driver.b1_text: Get passenger requests in your area and decide when to accept based on your availability.
driver.b2_text: Turn availability on or off whenever you want. Work the hours that suit you.
driver.b3_text: Follow the route on the map, coordinate pickup by chat, and close the trip on arrival.
driver.services_lead: Everything you need to operate as a mototaxi driver on Tuk Tuk.
driver.s1_text: Go online to receive nearby passenger requests and pause when you're unavailable.
driver.s2_text: Review origin, destination, and estimated fare before accepting the ride.
driver.s3_text: Manage trip status: on the way, picking up passenger, and completed.
driver.s4_text: See the route and passenger location throughout the service.
driver.s5_text: Review completed trips and your recent daily activity.
driver.s6_text: Operate under a cooperative or transport company with access key and plan quotas.
driver.how_lead: Register in the panel, join a fleet or create yours, and open the app.
driver.step1_text: Enter the company / cooperative panel and create or join a Tuk Tuk organization.
driver.step2_text: The admin adds you as a driver. You open the Tuki app and sign in.
driver.step3_text: Go online, accept nearby rides, and earn in your neighborhood.
driver.highlight_title: You can also run your own fleet
driver.highlight_text: If you are a cooperative or mototaxi company, the fleet panel lets you create the company, manage drivers, plans, wallet, and geographic channels.
driver.cta_title: Want to drive with Tuk Tuk?
driver.cta_text: Earn with your mototaxi, manage your schedule, and receive passenger requests near you. You can also run your own fleet from the company panel.

fleet.benefits_lead: The admin runs the fleet from the dashboard: create the company, choose a plan, invite drivers, control wallet, and define geographic channels by area.
fleet.a1_text: Register name, phone, and responsible person. Get the access key for drivers and operations.
fleet.a2_text: Invite by email, assign the driver role, and control the driver cap according to your plan.
fleet.a3_text: Choose Starter, Growth, Business, or Enterprise. Pay with ePayco and consume trips by quota.
fleet.a4_text: Configure geofences and neighborhood channels to show mototaxi supply in each zone.
fleet.a5_text: Monitor completed trips, wallet balance, cost per ride, and subscription validity.
fleet.a6_text: When you create the company, the selected plan quotas apply. Then renew with ePayco (30 days).
fleet.plans_title: Tuk Tuk plans for your fleet
fleet.plans_lead: Same structure as the admin dashboard: driver quotas, enabled trips, and cost per ride. 5-day trial on signup; paid plans renew with ePayco.
fleet.how_lead: From company registration to trip matching in the driver and passenger apps.
fleet.step1_text: Enter the dashboard, register the cooperative, and choose the plan to start your trial.
fleet.step2_text: Add emails, share the access key, and control quotas according to the contracted plan.
fleet.step3_text: Monitor wallet and trips. When the trial ends, pay with ePayco to renew for 30 days.
fleet.cta_title: Manage your cooperative with Tuk Tuk
fleet.cta_text: The company panel gives you fleet, plans, wallet, and geo channel control. Your drivers and passengers use the Tuki app in real time.

plans.starter_micro: Ideal to validate your business model with low risk
plans.business_micro: For companies that want to grow without technical limits
plans.enterprise_micro: For your own Uber / Rappi of mototaxis

footer.blurb: Mototaxi mobility for passengers, drivers, and cooperatives. We connect your neighborhood with fast, safe rides.
